chapter_title: The Seventh, concerning the Five Fathers
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
:
 The Five
 Orig
inating Principles

---


**
¶2:**
 Five orig
inating principles of all
 spiritual life exist
;
 each was
 called
 forth from the
 one
 before it. Each successive
 principle proceeds
 from the prior, as the
 Divine
 desc
ends through discrete
 degrees into
 manifest
ation.

**¶3:**
 The first orig
inating principle is the Divine Itself —
 Infinite Love in
 its own
 incomp
rehensible essence
,
 whose
 in
most nature exce
eds all finite understanding. It
 is the
 sole
 and absolute
 origin
,
 existing
 before
 all states of being that
 have
 been
 or shall
 be,
 containing
 within itself the full
ness of every
 principle
 that
 will
 proceed
 from it through
 all et
ernity.

**¶4:**
 From
 this
 Infinite Divine
 proceed
 three aspects
 of spiritual
 life. The first
 is the Divine
 Proceeding as
 a
 receiving
 and nurturing ground
 — the celestial principle,
 the matrix
 of all love
,
 the
 receptive origin
 through
 which life
 first
 flows
 out
ward.
 This
 comes
 forth
 first
 and
 appears
 before
 all
 else
.

**¶5:** The
 second proce
eding is
 the union
 of Divine
 Good
 with Divine Truth — the bond of love
 dwelling
 within
 wisdom
,
 the interior
 de
light of
 the Divine in
 its own rad
iant
 knowing
.
 This manif
ests directly
 from
 the Divine Itself.

**
¶6:** The third proceeding is
 Divine
 Truth accommodated and sent forth as a
 mediating principle,
 the
 first
 among
 all
 counsel
ing
 and
 governing
 tru
ths,
 iss
uing from the Divine to
 desc
end toward
 what
 lies
 below.

**¶7:**
 This
 is
 the first originating principle:
 the first
 and
 in
most power, the root
 of
 all wisdom
,
 from
 which
 the three great proce
eding powers come
 forth
. These
 three
 have
 overcome falsity.
 They have brought the
 deep
est intention
 of evil to nothing. They have established
 the sovereignty of good within
 themselves
 and
 within
 all the
 states of life
 that
 belong
 to them.

**¶8
:** The second originating principle,
 proce
eding from the first, is the medi
ating truth
 itself
 — Divine Truth now
 functioning
 as a
 further source
, p
atter
ned after the order
 of the Divine
.
 From
 this principle
,
 too
, three powers
 are
 called
 forth and
 sent out.

**¶9
:** The
 first
 is
 the sustaining truth that upholds all
 spiritual
 order
 — the complete form of the
 regenerate human
, the structural principle of Divine
 arrangement
 upon
 which everything
 r
ests,
 the one
 support
 greater
 than every
 other support
.

**¶10:** The
 second is Divine
 Truth made fully
 manifest and
 rad
iant — saving
 wisdom
 through
 which
 conjunction
 with the Divine,
 which
 is eternal
 life
, is given to all
 who
 receive
 it.

**¶11:**
 The third is the pure
 aff
ection for
 truth dwelling
 in
 innoc
ence —
 interior
 wisdom itself
, which by
 its very form dis
arms the ruling
 falsities and the
 dom
inating self
-loves
 of
 the natural
 mind
, drawing
 their
 power away
,
 as
 this
 innoc
ence fulfills the entire
 purpose of the Divine.

**
¶12:** The third originating principle
, proceeding from the second, is
 this
 same
 saving
 wisdom now
 become
 itself
 a source
.
 It
,
 too, calls
 forth three further
 aspects
 of spiritual
 life,
 following
 the pattern established
 by the principle
 above
 it
.

**¶14:** The
 second power called
 forth by
 saving
 wisdom is the principle
 of spiritual discernment — the truth
 that distingu
ishes and
 evaluates every interior state of the human
 mind.
 Its
 operation
 is established in the intermediate realm between the
 higher
 celest
ial states and the natural
 cognitions below
.
 *

 text refer
encing "wheel
" and "stars" likely
 corresponds
 to the cycles
 of spiritual states
 and the kn
owledges of truth
 in the
 natural
 mind
,
 but
 the fragment
ary condition
 res
ists certain
ty.
]*

**¶16:** The
 fourth originating principle is interior
 perception illumin
ated
 by Divine
 Truth — the understanding
 that recogn
izes,
 selects, and viv
ifies every
 receptive community of faith and charity.
 This,
 too, calls
 forth three powers
 p
atterned after the saving
 wisdom above
 it
.

**¶20:** The
 fifth originating principle is the interior spiritual
 form itself
 — the form
 of
 truth and
 good
 that becomes visible to every soul as
 it departs from the
 natural state of
 the
 body
, shaped
 according to the pattern that
 the
 teaching truth has
 established
.
 Three
 active Divine truths —
 minist
ering per
ceptions
 of
 good
 —
 accompany this
 form as
 it appears
.


**¶22:** These are
 the five originating principles of
 all
 spiritual life, each proceeding from the
 one before it.
 Each
 manifests through the others, for
 the
 Divine descends through successive degrees —
 from
 the
 Infinite
 Itself,
 through accommod
ated truth
, through saving
 wisdom, through interior perception, to
 the very
 form
 that
 meets
 the depar
ting soul —
 and
 in
 this chain
 of proce
eding, the
 whole
 of spiritual creation
 is contained
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Five fathers exist; they were summoned forth one of one. [Also], one did come out of another!

The first Father is the Father of Greatness, the blessed one of glory, the [on]e who has no measure to his greatness; who also is the first only-begotten, the first eternal; who exists with fiv[e fa]thers for ever; the one who exists before every thing that has existed, and that will exist.
Now he, the glorious Father, summoned from him three emanations. The [fi]rst is the Gre[at] Spirit, the first Mother, who came out of the Father. She appeared first.
The seco[nd i]s the Belo[ved of] the Lights, the great glorious Beloved, [the one w]ho is honour[ed; w]ho came out of the Father. [He ma]nifested ou[t of h]im.

This is the first Father, the first power, the one from whom the three great powers came out. This is the first Father, the first eternal, the root of all the lights; from whom the three emanations came out. They have humiliated the Darkness. They have brought its heart's desire to naught. They have given themselves the victory. They have also given the victory to their aeons.
The second father, who came out of the first Father, is the Third Ambassador, the model of the King of lights. And again, he too summoned and sent out of him three powers.
One is the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man; the one who bears up under all things; the great Pillar of blessing; the great porter, who is greater than all the porters.
The second is glorious Jesus the Splendour; [the] one through whom shall be given life eternal.
The third is the Virgin of Light, the glorious wisd[o]m; the one who takes away the heart of the [rul]ers and the powers by her image, as she fulfils the pleas[u]re of the greatness.
The third father, who came out of the second father: he is glorious Jesus the Splendour. And, again, he too summoned three evocations after the pattern of the second father.
The second power whom Jesus summo[n]ed is the gre[at Jud]ge, who gives judgement on all the souls of mankind, [his] dwelling being established in the atmosphere under [the] wheel [of the] stars.
The fourth father is the Light Mind, the one who chooses all the churches. And, again, he too summoned three powers after the pattern of Jesus.

And also the fifth father is this Light Form; the one who shall appear to everyone who will go out from his body, corresponding to the pattern of the image to the apostle; and the thr[ee] great glorious angels who are come with her.
These are the five fathers who have come out of one another. They have appeared and man[ifes]ted through one another!
The third father is the Thir[d Ambassador], the eldest of [a]]] the counsell[ors; who came out of] the first Father. He appeared.
